content.heroHeading: Learn the Quran with Care, Patience and Purpose.
content.heroSubheading: Personalised One-to-One Online Quran Classes for Children and Adults.
content.heroDescription: Begin your Quran learning journey with Maarif ul Quran. We provide personalised online Quran education with qualified teachers, individual attention and a friendly, supportive learning environment.
content.aboutSubheading: Making Quran Learning Accessible, Personal and Meaningful.
content.aboutMission: To make quality Quran education accessible through patient teaching, individual attention and consistent guidance.
content.aboutVision: To help children and adults build a lasting connection with the Holy Quran and develop essential Islamic knowledge.
content.feesApproachTitle: Accessible Quran Education for Every Family
content.feesApproachQuote: At Maarif ul Quran, our priority is to make Quran education accessible, not expensive. We do not put a price on the Holy Quran or its teachings. Our fees simply support the time, effort and dedication of our teachers. We strive to keep our learning options very affordable so that more families can benefit. Please feel free to contact us without worrying about the fees.
